name: codex-1m
description: Unlock Codex's long-context mode with five simple commands to install, enable, inspect, disable, or remove the integration.

interface.shortDescription: Unlock Codex long context in five commands
interface.longDescription: Adds an MCP server and Skill that route five case-insensitive commands to install, uninstall, enable, disable, and inspect a 1,000,000-token context request; the verified Codex environment caps expected usable input at approximately 828,400 tokens.
